content:
maria: Quick note 12 - new onboarding feedback: error messages in the sampleapp are ambiguous. Users don't know whether to retry or re-auth.

kevin: which SDKs show this?

maria: JS + Python repros. Go hasn't run through the new tutorial. Example from client console:
```
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized",
  "message": "Auth failed calling /v1/chat"
}
```
The UI shows: `Request failed: Unauthorized` with no hint.

sam: yikes. UX needs a clear action hint. Either automatic refresh or a prompt.

raj: parity issue alert 13 - JS beta returns AuthError with .step = "refresh". Python surfaces a 401 string. Go returns raw HTTP error. We should standardize.

nisha: proposal: server returns structured error envelope for key cases. Fields: type, code, retryable (bool), retry_hint (enum: none|immediate|fixed|exponential), retry_after (secs opt), auth_step (opt), user_message, docs_url, error_id. Example: 
```
{
  "type": "AuthError",
  "code": "auth.invalid_token",
  "retryable": false,
  "auth_step": "refresh",
  "user_message": "Your session expired. Re-authenticate to continue.",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#auth",
  "error_id": "err_02Xabc"
}
```

maria: +1. For rate limits: 429 -> RateLimitError, retryable:true, retry_hint:fixed, and surface Retry-After header if present. For 502/503/504 -> TransientError + exponential.

kevin: SDK tasks: JS already has a RateLimitError class; i'll implement the full envelope parsing in Python and add typed exceptions to Go. Also add a small helper: error.isRetryable() and error.retryHint().

sam: sampleapp change: show `user_message` in toast and fallback to a friendly generic: "Something went wrong. Try again or contact support." Also if auth_step=="refresh" show a re-login CTA. I'll open `sampleapp/error-hints` branch.

ops-bot: ops: created ticket #4543 to ensure server includes error_id and forwards Retry-After.

nisha: docs: i'll add an HTTP->error mapping table and snippet for client retry logic (pseudocode for exponential backoff consuming retry_hint enum).

maria: a few constraints: 1) don't include sensitive data in user_message, 2) error_id required in server logs for trace linking, 3) keep machine fields stable (code, type, retry_hint) so SDKs can rely on them.

kevin: timeline? aim for a patch release for JS/Python next week. Go follow-up after.

sam: i'll validate flows on Thurs.

nisha: docs PR by Wed EOD.

maria: thanks everyone. this should cut onboarding tickets. ping me for copy reviews (:speech_balloon:).
